command.customized_spice_of_nostalgia.re: Reset all expectations to initial values for %s
tooltip.customized_spice_of_nostalgia.fo: Current Diversity Score：%s Food Expectation：%s Saturation Expectation：%s
fml.menu.mods.info.description.customize: A lightweight mod that adds an intelligent eating penalty system to the vanilla game, encouraging players to prepare higher-tier foods.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.dec: Decrease Food Expectation When Wake Up
Decrease Saturation Expectation When Wake Up
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.ini: This value determines the player's initial food expectation.
This value determines the player's initial saturation expectation.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.foo: This value determines the rate at which food expectation decreases.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.sat: This value determines the rate at which saturation expectation decreases.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.max: The maximum value for food expectation.
The maximum value for saturation expectation.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.nut: The maximum reduction ratio for nutrition.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.sat: The maximum reduction ratio for saturation.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.max: This value determines the player's max recent add size.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.can: When enabled, cancels the calculation when the player is enough hungry.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.dec: The amount to decrease food expectation value when the player wakes up.
The amount to decrease saturation expectation value when the player wakes up.
customized_spice_of_nostalgia.config.sho: This boolean value corresponds to whether to show the player food data tooltip.
